name: Models
tagline: An app's own domain types, from one compact line a type.
description:
An app's own domain types, written as Swift from one compact line a type. Say `Recipe "a dish": id String, title String, minutes Int = 30, author Cook?, steps [Step]` and `Course: starter | main | dessert`; Models writes a file a type into the folder the call names, each one Codable, Hashable and Sendable, Identifiable when it has an id, with an explicit initializer and a `preview` value for SwiftUI previews and tests.

A field with a default decodes as its default when the JSON leaves it out, so a persisted store keeps reading after a field is added. A `unify` line makes one type from another API's: `FederatedPost from LemmyPost: id = String(post.id), title = post.name`.

No model is asked: the same lines make the same files every time. A line it cannot read is refused with the reason, every bad line at once, and nothing is written until every file parses.

One of the Rao Craft Agents: independent packages that, tagged in prompts along the life of a project, build an app of Loom's quality.
